name: flat already rented — the fifteen-second early exit

turns.text: Hello — I'm an AI assistant calling for a tenant about your listing in Whitefield. This will take under a minute, and I am recording it so she can hear your answers. Is that alright?
When can she come and see the flat?
Sorry, that flat is rented out already. Tenant moved in on the first.
Understood, thank you for your time.
